fixes: Three rounds without a correct bar + doll + halo together; the props are the problem, not the style. 1) Make the control bar small and unambiguous: '1.3::a small wooden marionette control bar, a short handle with one short crossbar, the size of her hand::'; negative 'large cross, X shape, crucifix, long planks, rolling pin'. 2) Tie the doll to it: '1.3::a small cute doll marionette with a lilac bob, big friendly eyes and a sailor uniform hangs below the bar on thin lilac strings, the strings attached to the doll's hands and head::'; negative 'blank face, faceless doll, doll on shoulder, hand puppet, creepy doll'. 3) Pose: use pose 1 (doll dances toward the viewer, foreshortened, she steers from behind with the bar raised) as the lead; drop pose 0 and 2 (both give a static front-on bust). 4) Halo: '1.2::small pale lilac crescent-moon halo directly above her head::, whole halo inside the frame'; negative 'large crescent, crescent behind head'. 5) If round 4 still fails the bar, the owner may consider dropping the bar and keeping only the doll on strings from her gloved fingers.
safety_flags: r3-2 (and r3-0): crossed wooden planks held at the chest read as a religious cross; not a hard safety fail but avoid in future prompts.
